Suggest a place

This is a list of central London places you can turn up to, stay a while, and pay nothing. Suggestions are read by a person before anything is published, so there is no rush and nothing goes live automatically.

This form sends nothing anywhere. It writes out a message for you to copy into an email, because this site has no server and collects nothing about you.

The four things a place has to be

All four have to be true. If one of them is not, this is not the right list for the place — which is a fact about the list, not about the place.

Optional — somewhere like “top floor, by the window”.

A street and area is plenty. An OpenStreetMap link saves a lookup, but is not expected.

One sentence, up to 200 characters. What does this place not ask of you?

Ways to support the place, if there are any

Listed on the site and never ranked or ordered by. A place with none of these is not worse than a place with four.

Optional. Leave empty for no credit.

Copy this into an email

Nothing has been sent for you. Copy the message below, then reveal the address to send it to.
